content.text:
The robot made it to the end of the corridor and is now resting in front of the green panel, which fills most of the camera view.

1. It walked about 4.3 m straight down the first part of the corridor until it reached the far wall.
2. The corridor turned left there, so it turned 90° left and saw the green panel at the far end.
3. It walked about 2.1 m toward the panel. Collision protection stopped it once because it had drifted too close to the right-hand wall.
4. It stepped about 1 m to the left to get back to the middle of the corridor, then walked the last 1.4 m up to the panel.
5. It called `rest` and is now crouched with motors off. It didn't fall at any point.

The sonar read about 0.5–0.67 m at the end, but in that narrow spot it may be picking up the side walls rather than the panel. Going by the camera, the robot is close to the panel and roughly centred on it.
